body: Woodleigh Fringe is the shortlist when newer condo stock and NEL adjacency matter more than CBD skyline premiums. The pocket sits on the Woodleigh / Potong Pasir / Bidadari edges; housing mixes recent condos and selective HDB. Expats land here for car-light hops to Serangoon / Dhoby Ghaut and park-connector weekends.
